# Objective

- Fixes #12905.

## Solution

- Use proper code `` tags for `TaskPoolBuilder::thread_name`.
- Remove leftover documentation in `TaskPool` referencing the deleted `TaskPoolInner` struct.
  - It may be possible to rephrase this, but I do not know enough about the task pool to write something. (cc @james7132 who made the change removing `TaskPoolInner`.)
- Ignore a buggy rustdoc lint that thinks `App` is already in scope for `UpdateMode` doc. (Extracted from #12692.)

review_comments: You seem to have accidentally changed the `threads` doc comment into a normal comment.
Note that doc comments on private fields don't seem to show up in the documentation even when `--document-private-items` is used.

> You seem to have accidentally changed the `threads` doc comment into a normal comment.

This was intentional. The comment used to refer to a single field, `TaskPoolInner`, but later was split into two separate fields. Instead of duplicating the doc comment, I chose to make it a regular one.
